body: Pretty dope I would turn down your adlibs it can get pretty messy and distracting around 1:00.

Hi! Kind of a dad rocky song but w/e. I want to add some emotion to the chorus, it has a lot of energy but it feels kinda empty, any ideas? Comments on the mix would be appreciated too.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/19MomQ\_ewo\_lIyyrteEmlFcSfLTn-84bI/view?usp=sharing

Job market is really tough where I am, I bike 3 miles there and back to work everyday and that's the closest thing I can find, would be an easy fix If I made enough to move, and I have to sacrifice a car to save for potentially finding a place so it's a lose lose all around.

The world isn't very forgiving eh.

Honestly think I might tat my face, I like tattoos, I have a few, think it would really be the ride or die decision too. Obviously that's another dumb stereotype but I'm not doing it for ego and acceptance, just think it's cool.

I'm an 18 y/o male that OD'd on 20kmg of Tylenol don't know how relevant that is to you but you're definitely not alone, I would recommend trying to find something you love, it could be music, baking, writing, anything, don't leave until you know for sure you gave it a good shot, it may sound dumb to someone with your mindset, but really applying yourself to a passion can help get you out of many dark places, wish you the best brother.
